title: The ticks skill teaches the ticfac verbs 2jn shipped (ticfac run, not ticfac run-epic)
description: From ticfac epic-2jn finding a009316a (tick xbp): the ticks skill says 'Start a run with ticfac run-epic <epic>'; ticfac's skill teaches 'ticfac run <epic>' since ticfac 2jn (9sz). Say only that execution is ticfac's and point at the ticfac skill for verbs, so the two cannot drift again.
acceptance_criteria: The ticks skill carries no instruction to start a run with run-epic; it defers run verbs to the ticfac skill
